sources.snippet: Whisper-Large-V3-Turbo Transformer‑based automatic speech recognition (ASR) model for multilingual transcription and translation available on HuggingFace. Whisper large‑v3‑turbo is a finetuned version of a pruned Whisper large‑v3. In other words, it's the exact same model, except that the number of decoding layers have reduced from 32 to 4. sources.snippet: We're releasing a new Whisper model named large-v3-turbo, or turbo for short. It is an optimized version of Whisper large-v3 and has only 4 decoder layers—just like the tiny model—down from the 32 in the large series.
